boundary_validation.precondition: Column names must be unique.
Wrangle never mutates input data; use the returned table.
A column needs a consistent native dtype.
Data fields need consistent native types; declare casts explicitly.
Each data row must have the same number of fields.
Nested list fields need consistent native types.
Nested object fields need consistent native types.
Record fields must have string names; names are never coerced.
Record tables require one mapping per row; use null field values for missingness.
Rows without any fields cannot retain observation identity; supply at least one field.
Rows without any fields cannot retain observation identity; supply at least one named field.
This operation requires exactly one column.
Use a Polars Series, one-column table, or list of values.
Use a Polars table, series, Python records, or a local CSV/Parquet path.
Use native Polars values; opaque Python objects cannot represent research data.
Mixed integers and floats exceed the safe Float64 integer range; declare a dtype explicitly.
The requested columns are absent.

navigation.select_operation: Choose the task in docs/recipes.md. Read returns/recipe eligibility, then exact arguments, literal argument_constraints and validation. Resolve symbol or open source at line. Minimal workflows in navigation assert expected data and receipts. Signatures, choice constraints and failures come from engine definitions.

operations.description: Annotate rows with group-safe random or chronological partitions; retain every observation.
operations.name: partition

validation.precondition: Each sampling group needs one stratum, weight, and declared time assignment.
Chronological boundaries require numeric, Date, or Datetime time values.
A boundary cannot be parsed into the time column dtype.
Allocation shares need a representable exact decimal ratio.
Boundaries cannot be parsed to the declared time dtype.
Chronological boundaries must be strictly increasing.
Chronological partition takes boundaries/time and no randomness.
Chronological partitions need a time column and one boundary between adjacent labels.
Group units require groups; row units require groups=[].
Numeric boundaries must be finite numbers.
Random partition takes fractions and seed, without chronology options.
Temporal boundaries must be ISO date/datetime strings.
f"{name} must be one of {', '.join(choices)}."
f'{name} must be a list of column names.'
f'{name} must contain distinct column names.'
fractions require one positive share per label, summing to one.
groups and strata must be disjoint; a group cannot also be its own stratum.
labels require at least two distinct nonempty strings.
seed must be an integer from 0 through 2**64 - 1.
A boundary cannot be represented exactly in the time column dtype.
Boundary precision exceeds the time column's declared unit.
Ordering, grouping, and identity columns require observed values.
Output names must be nonempty and absent from the input.

recipe_contract: Author recipe files in strict YAML (.yaml/.yml) using mappings, lists, strings, Boolean/null values and finite numbers; programmatic Python mappings share the same contract. Canonical JSON is internal receipt/hash serialization. Guided pending_decisions block execution before source access; recorded research_decisions must be complete and agree with controlled preparation steps. Conditional legacy operations require table-returning arguments. Existing keys retain identity; declare step.key for an explicit checked transition. Canonical grain operations require step.key even without an input key. Exclusions require reasons, expansion requires allow_expand, and incompatible measurement units cannot be reconciled by annotations.
recovery: Read operation validation plus shared_validation and boundary_validation. Use WrangleError.code/details to correct that declared precondition and rerun the same protocol; never silently substitute a method or discard observations.
